blocks.text: Needs review by a South African attorney before use. This is a drafting outline, not legal advice and not an approved document. The statutes and instruments named are pointers for the reviewer: POPIA (Act 4 of 2013) section 14.

items: Confirm the end date in writing (lib-cancellation-notice).
Agree how data is returned and who receives it.
Export the school’s data and check it.
Return it by a secure route.
Erase through the retention and tombstone path.
Send the final statement of account.
Close access and record the closure.
